name: brompheniramine
uses: Uses ▪ temporarily relieves: ▪ runny nose ▪ sneezing ▪ itchy, watery eyes due to hay fever ▪ itching of the nose or throat
otcwarn: Do not use ▪ to sedate a child or to make a child sleepy Ask a doctor before use if you have ▪ trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland ▪ glaucoma ▪ a breathing problem such as emphysema, or chronic bronchitis. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are ▪ taking sedatives or tranquilizers
